window: Covering reporting published since the Sept 12 edition, roughly Sept 12-13, with a few incident dates running back to Sept 8-9 where South American and Nigerian reporting lagged. South America again got dedicated Spanish-language effort, turning up two distinct Colombian operations. Excluded after review: a recirculating 'DEA-led raid off Ecuador nets 3,284 kilos of cocaine' story that remains sourced only to an undated DEA social-media post with no named agencies, date or location; a widely-reported 'HMS Trent narco-submarine' cocaine seizure off the Dominican Republic that turned out to be a 2024 operation being recirculated, not new; Colombia's 'Operation Nexus' (46.8 tonnes, announced Sept 2) and 'Zeus Arcano III' (4.6 tonnes, announced Aug 31), both now too stale for this window; a Massachusetts fentanyl bust and an Indiana meth lab story that duplicate incidents already logged; and a Pakistani ANF university-area sweep and a Nigerian heroin-kingpin arrest, both about five days stale with nothing new to add. No genuinely new development surfaced on the SOUTHCOM boat-strike or refueling-vessel campaigns, the Los Tiguerones case, or Uruguay's Artigas airdrop case since the last edition, so the ongoing section is empty today.
